Synopsis:
A fast-moving, wind-driven wildfire (the Hawk Fire) northwest of Reno, Nevada has forced ~90,000 residents to evacuate. The fire has burned 15,000+ acres with 0% containment, caused power outages to ~10,000 homes/businesses, and prompted a state of emergency declaration. ~800 firefighters are deployed, including crews from Australia and New Zealand. Some weather relief (afternoon showers) is possible.
